description:
Use this when the user wants several Indian indices compared on return, volatility and drawdown over the same period.

Compare 2 to 10 NSE indices over the same window: return, volatility, drawdown.

    `indices` are NSE index names, e.g. ["Nifty 50", "Nifty Bank"] (case-insensitive; a miss lists the valid
    names). Window: `days` back from the newest stored day (default 365, max 1825) or `from_date`/
    `to_date`. Per index: price return %, annualised volatility of daily returns (x sqrt 252), maximum
    drawdown, best and worst day, from NSE's own daily closes. Arithmetic on published closes; no
    recommendation. For one index's OHLC and P/E use
    get_index_valuation.
name: compare_indices
title: Compare indices
